For damaged or defective parts, the policy I found says One Fast Cat will replace the affected components free of charge within the first 60 days.
I also found a warranty note stating that if parts arrive broken/defective, or break during assembly, they offer replacement parts free of charge up to 90 days after purchase, and you should submit a photo of the affected part through their portal.
I did not find anything saying a damaged item is refunded instead of replaced, unless it goes through the standard return process. The return policy does say refunds require the item to be shipped back.
So based on what I found: damaged items appear to be handled as replacement/warranty cases, while refunds follow the normal return policy.
